scope.purpose: Select sources for the locked Sorani calibration, acceptance, reserve, and supporting-comparison splits before any candidate output or held-out verdict is examined.
principles: A dataset licence and a defensible voice-recording consent or stewardship basis are separate checks.
No source enters calibration, acceptance, or reserve because it is merely downloadable or described as public.
Raw speech, direct identifiers, and source client identifiers remain outside Git and the release artifacts.
Every acquired archive and generated split manifest is hash-locked before processing.
The source custodian, reviewers, and release code never attempt to identify a Common Voice contributor.

selection_policy.model_overlap_rule: Record known upstream model training sources. Unknown overlap is a limitation; a named or fingerprint-confirmed overlap with a held-out item excludes that item.

common_voice_26_ckb.selection: Freeze prompt-, clip-, and client-disjoint samples after archive verification; balance declared demographics where available without inferring missing attributes.

fresh_consented_field.selection: Natural, non-synthetic coverage of the locked dialect, room, device, noise, reverb, codec, clipping-risk, music-bleed, and low-bandwidth strata.

recommended_route.rationale: Common Voice supplies a current, versioned, speaker-keyed public backbone large enough for the statistical floor. Fresh consented recordings add the natural Sorani dialect and acoustic conditions that read-speech corpora cannot prove. FLEURS and Gigant are useful calibration or comparison material but do not count toward the primary speaker/diversity proof.

sources.name: Common Voice Scripted Speech 26.0 - Central Kurdish
sources.rights_basis: Mozilla Data Collective dataset licence and terms; user acceptance of the exact version terms is still required.
constraints: Do not attempt to determine contributor identity.
Do not re-host or re-share the source dataset.
Use only validated clips and retain the hashed client_id solely for split integrity.
Self-declared demographic and accent metadata are sparse and must never be inferred.
Hash-lock the exact 3.62 GB archive and every selected clip before candidate generation.
blocking_conditions: explicit source-route approval
exact archive acquisition and SHA-256 verification
machine validation of client-disjoint splits and source terms

sources.name: Owner-commissioned Sorani field and studio collection
sources.licence: participant release and data-use agreement required before recording
sources.rights_basis: Direct, documented participant consent for commercial product validation, processing, qualified review, retained anonymized evidence, and publication of aggregate results.
constraints: Consent must precede recording and define any withdrawal deadline before split freeze.
Collect the minimum necessary demographics; store contact and consent records outside Git.
Acceptance, reserve, and calibration speakers must be disjoint.
Record natural conditions rather than manufacturing all degradations after capture.
No minor is included without a separately reviewed guardian/participant protocol.
blocking_conditions: approved collection and consent documents
at least 60 qualified speakers and 300 usable units
rights and audio-metadata completeness audit

sources.name: FLEURS Central Kurdish (ckb_iq)
sources.rights_basis: Official FLEURS dataset card; attribution is required.
sources.local_state: audio archives and TSV manifests present
constraints: The local TSV has no stable speaker identifier.
Use only as calibration/supporting comparison under the official predefined split, never to satisfy the 45-speaker primary floor.
Keep attribution and the exact local revision/file hashes.

sources.name: Gigant KTTS / Bridging the Gap
sources.rights_basis: Mendeley Data version-specific licence; attribution is required.
constraints: The authoritative description identifies one Kurdish male dubber despite filename prefixes.
Use only for clean-studio calibration and supporting comparison; never count it as speaker diversity.

sources.name: KASET - Kurmanji and Sorani Kurdish Speech and Transcripts
sources.rights_basis: Use requires a qualifying LDC licence and compliance review; no package is currently held.
sources.speaker_key: documented for telephone collection; broadcast identity coverage requires package inspection
constraints: Contains both Kurmanji and Sorani and must be language-filtered.
Cannot enter any split until the exact LDC agreement and package metadata are reviewed.
May be valuable for telephone/broadcast supporting comparisons but cannot satisfy the primary speaker floor as currently documented.
blocking_conditions: qualifying LDC licence
package-level language, speaker, consent/stewardship, and metadata audit

sources.name: A Comprehensive Central Kurdish Sound Dataset
sources.rights_basis: Dataset licence is stated, but speaker-level stewardship/consent and complete audio-package identity are not documented in the local manifest.
sources.local_state: CSV/TSV metadata only; linked audio not present
constraints: No speaker identifier is available for speaker-disjoint splitting.
The local manifest has duplicate paths and does not bind the linked audio package.
Do not infer speaker identity from voice embeddings as a substitute for source consent or identity records.
blocking_conditions: author-supplied speaker IDs and recording stewardship/consent basis
exact audio acquisition and complete hash/metadata reconciliation

sources.name: AsoSoft Speech Corpus public subset
sources.rights_basis: The repository README does not grant the commercial compatibility required by this release evaluation.
constraints: Do not use for HawaVoClean release evidence without written permission covering the intended commercial product validation.
blocking_conditions: written commercial evaluation permission or a compatible version-specific licence

sources.name: CORDI - Corpus of Dialogues in Central Kurdish
sources.rights_basis: Repository licence is explicit, but the audio derives from movies and television; the paper documents volunteer annotator consent rather than performer or underlying-media permission.
constraints: Do not treat public broadcast or YouTube availability as performer or recording rights.
Do not use until counsel or the rightsholder supplies a source-specific commercial evaluation basis.
Speaker metadata is incomplete and source dialect can differ from a performer's native dialect.
blocking_conditions: documented underlying media and performer rights suitable for this use
speaker and clip metadata completeness review

sources.name: akam-ot/ckb_tts
sources.rights_basis: No authoritative licence, recording source, speaker identity key, or consent/stewardship basis is present.
sources.local_state: three Parquet shards and README present
constraints: Do not use any audio until all rights and speaker metadata blockers close.
blocking_conditions: authoritative compatible licence
recording provenance and consent/stewardship basis
stable speaker IDs

sources.name: CKB-New-Speech-Corpus volunteer/YouTube proposal
sources.rights_basis: The local proposal describes Telegram volunteers and YouTube broadcast extraction without a source-specific licence or complete participant consent record.
constraints: YouTube or broadcast availability is not a licence.
Volunteer collection requires the same pre-recording consent and custody rules as fresh_consented_field.
blocking_conditions: source-specific licences and participant consent records
stable speaker IDs and complete audio metadata

sources.name: Unclassified local or private Sorani recordings
sources.rights_basis: No private recording is presumed reusable from its presence on disk.
constraints: Do not inspect, copy, hash, or use private recordings without source-specific user approval and a rights record.
Never commit private audio, direct identifiers, or consent documents.
blocking_conditions: source-specific user approval
rights, consent, and speaker metadata record

deepfilternet3.limitation: The paper-level list is not a per-file training manifest. Exact fingerprint exclusion remains impossible without an upstream manifest.

project_calibration.rule: No acceptance or reserve item, output, verdict, aggregate, speaker key, prompt, or near-duplicate may enter HawaVoClean calibration.
